metadata.description: Rough-terrain scenario: wheel slip and a co-occurring IMU bias. The encoder under-reports velocity (slip) while the IMU shows a measurable bias. Together these drive the supervisor to ACTIVE_DEGRADED through the bias-detection and confidence paths. The slip itself is observable via the encoder stream and the fault_injection.fired event, but slip-only disagreement is below the supervisor's angular threshold in the current architecture (state-estimator-based slip detection is Phase 2 work).
